title: WebhookRequest
description: One delivery of a customer message from wa_mock to ingestion (POST /webhook).

customer_id.description: Customer identifier, used as the partition key.

t_customer.description: RFC 3339 time at which the customer sent the message.

delivery_attempt.description: 1 for the first delivery, higher for redeliveries.

edge_case.description: Optional label set by the generator.
